name: Spring Boot 3.5 Enterprise Microservice Baseline
build_file_template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.5.0</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>
    <groupId>{{GROUP_ID}}</groupId>
    <artifactId>{{ARTIFACT_ID}}</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>{{PROJECT_NAME}}</name>
    <description>Modernized Target Enterprise Microservice</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
        <archunit.version>1.3.0</archunit.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.tngtech.archunit</groupId>
            <artifactId>archunit-junit5</artifactId>
            <version>${archunit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

conformance_rules.description: Controllers must only access Services and must not depend directly on Repositories.
conformance_rules.rule_code:
noClasses()
        .that().resideInAPackage("..controller..")
        .or().resideInAPackage("..web..")
        .should().dependOnClassesThat().resideInAPackage("..repository..")
        .because("Controllers must interact with repositories only through domain services")

conformance_rules.description: Domain services must declare Spring Service or Transactional boundaries.
conformance_rules.rule_code:
classes()
        .that().resideInAPackage("..service..")
        .and().areTopLevelClasses()
        .and().areNotInterfaces()
        .should().beAnnotatedWith(org.springframework.stereotype.Service.class)
        .orShould().beAnnotatedWith(org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional.class)
        .because("Business domain services must declare Spring bean or transaction boundaries")

conformance_rules.description: Domain JPA/persistence entities must not be accessed directly by presentation controllers.
conformance_rules.rule_code:
noClasses()
        .that().resideInAPackage("..controller..")
        .or().resideInAPackage("..web..")
        .should().dependOnClassesThat().resideInAPackage("..domain..")
        .orShould().dependOnClassesThat().resideInAPackage("..entity..")
        .because("Presentation controllers must communicate exclusively via DTOs and records")

conformance_rules.description: Classes in controller packages must have names ending with 'Controller'.
conformance_rules.rule_code:
classes()
        .that().resideInAPackage("..controller..")
        .and().areTopLevelClasses()
        .should().haveSimpleNameEndingWith("Controller")
        .because("Controller classes must follow enterprise naming conventions")
